name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  March 26, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room
“A” 1st Floor on March 26, 2026, at 2:30 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra C. Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Hugo Jacome on behalf of of Buzzhive Production / Hugo to host a Rams Draft
  House 2026 (Merch Pop) Event at 1237 District Dr D; Private Property; on Thursday,
  April 16, 2026 – Sunday April 26, 2026 from 10:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. Per The Chair
  request the Application was pulled from the agenda; Motion carried unanimously to
  pull the item from the P&L Agenda (Activity No. 00426770)

Item #2:  Hug Jacome on behalf of Buzzhive Productions / Hugo to host a Rams Draft House
  2026 (Carvinal) Event at 1250 District Dr D; Private Property; on Thursday, April 23,
  2026, from 10:00 p.m – 8:00 p.m., Friday, April 24, 2026, from 3:00 p.m. -9:00 p.m.
  and Saturday, April 25, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for a three (3) day event within Hollywood Park. Must
  submit for the Building Safety plan check. Must comply with the HPSP; Applicant
  will need to hire IPD staffing of 1 sergeant and 4 police officers for public safety (this
  may increase by 2 officers for a total of 6 police officers if the special events unit
  deems it necessary). Applicant to hire a minimum of 20 professional licensed
  security guards to assist IPD with any potential crowd control. Security staff to be
  deployed at points of ingress-egress of the event; Applicant shall submit a list of the
  carnival workers that will be working this event. IPD will need to conduct a public
  safety check to ensure that there are NO 290 sex registrants working this event;
  there will be no alcohol sales at this event.at this event; Adhere to all local, state,
   and federal laws. None Code Enforcement Conditions; None additional conditions
  for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426771)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
